# Paths that gate the "Recovery media E2E (QEMU)" job (classifier output `agent`).
#
# The job builds exactly two Go commands — cmd/breeze-backup and
# cmd/breeze-recovery-fakeserver — and the recovery-media/ scripts, then boots
# the ISO in QEMU. Only the packages those commands import can change its
# outcome, so a change anywhere else under agent/ (SNMP, heartbeat, remote
# desktop, PAM, ...) does not run it.
#
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND to add a package. This file is the classifier's view of
# `go list -deps ./cmd/breeze-backup ./cmd/breeze-recovery-fakeserver`;
# agent/cmd/breeze-backup/ci_gate_test.go recomputes that set and fails when
# this file drifts. When a new import lands, the Go test tells you the exact
# line to add. Paths are repo-relative; a trailing slash means "and everything
# under it"; a bare file matches only itself.
#
# Non-package inputs of the job:
agent/go.mod
agent/go.sum
agent/recovery-media/
# Go packages (module-internal transitive deps of the two commands):
agent/cmd/breeze-backup/
agent/cmd/breeze-recovery-fakeserver/
agent/internal/authstate/
agent/internal/backup/
agent/internal/backup/bmr/
agent/internal/backup/bmr/fakeserver/
agent/internal/backup/hyperv/
agent/internal/backup/layout/
agent/internal/backup/mssql/
agent/internal/backup/providers/
agent/internal/backup/rebuild/
agent/internal/backup/systemstate/
agent/internal/backup/vss/
agent/internal/backup/wingpt/
agent/internal/backup/winhive/
agent/internal/backupipc/
agent/internal/config/
agent/internal/hostpolicy/
agent/internal/httputil/
agent/internal/ipc/
agent/internal/logging/
agent/internal/recoveryconsole/
agent/internal/secmem/
agent/internal/securefs/
agent/internal/wire/
